title: Changes in Funeral Practices
synopsis: Learn about a new take on an old tradition.

fullText.simplified:
殡葬的新变化

     “入土为安”是中国特有的丧葬观念。中国人认为只有这样做，才能让亡者安息、生者安心。所以即使中国已经从传统土葬改成了火葬，“入土为安”的传统仍然没有变。
    近些年随着人们观念的更新，骨灰存放方式也悄悄发生了改变。在火葬的基础上出现了很多新的方式。比如，“绿色殡葬”，这是一种把骨灰直接葬入树下或草坪中的方式。人们将亲人骨灰、鲜花瓣和泥土一起葬在树根四周、草坪之中。绿色安葬象征着生命长绿、精神永存，也符合人们“入土为安”的传统观念。还有海葬，就是将骨灰撒入大海的葬法。骨灰撒海，冲破了传统的“入土为安”观念。人从自然中来，又回到自然中去。
    除了骨灰存放方式有了改变，人们对于骨灰的态度也发生了改变。现在很多年轻人会把去世亲人的骨灰做成饰品，比如戒指、项链等随身携带，这样就可以随时随地把亲人带在身边。
    在你的国家，人们会选择什么方式去纪念去世的亲人呢？
fullText.traditional:
殯葬的新變化

     “入土為安”是中國特有的喪葬觀念。中國人認為只有這樣做，才能讓亡者安息、生者安心。所以即使中國已經從傳統土葬改成了火葬，“入土為安”的傳統仍然沒有變。
    近些年隨著人們觀念的更新，骨灰存放方式也悄悄發生了改變。在火葬的基礎上出現了很多新的方式。比如，“綠色殯葬”，這是一種把骨灰直接葬入樹下或草坪中的方式。人們將親人骨灰、鮮花瓣和泥土一起葬在樹根四周、草坪之中。綠色安葬象徵著生命長綠、精神永存，也符合人們“入土為安”的傳統觀念。還有海葬，就是將骨灰撒入大海的葬法。骨灰撒海，衝破了傳統的“入土為安”觀念。人從自然中來，又回到自然中去。
    除了骨灰存放方式有了改變，人們對於骨灰的態度也發生了改變。現在很多年輕人會把去世親人的骨灰做成飾品，比如戒指、項鏈等隨身攜帶，這樣就可以隨時隨地把親人帶在身邊。
    在你的國家，人們會選擇什麼方式去紀念去世的親人呢？

sentences.traditional: “入土為安”是中國特有的喪葬觀念。
sentences.pinyin: rù tǔ wéi ān shì zhōng guó tè yǒu de sāng zàng guān niàn

sentences.traditional: 中國人認為只有這樣做，才能讓亡者安息、生者安心。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu zhè yàng zuò cái néng ràng wáng zhě ān xī shēng zhě ān xīn
sentences.english: “Burial brings peace to the deceased” is a unique funeral concept in China.

sentences.simplified: 所以即使中国已经从传统土葬改成了火葬，
sentences.traditional: 所以即使中國已經從傳統土葬改成了火葬，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ jí shǐ zhōng guó yǐ jīng cóng chuán tǒng tǔ zàng gǎi chéng le huǒ zàng
sentences.english: Chinese people believe that only with a burial can the deceased rest in peace, and the living be at peace.

sentences.simplified: “入土为安”的传统仍然没有变。
sentences.traditional: “入土為安”的傳統仍然沒有變。
sentences.pinyin: rù tǔ wéi ān de chuán tǒng réng rán méi yǒu biàn
sentences.english: Therefore, although traditional burial has been replaced by cremation in China, ..
.. the tradition that “burial brings peace to the deceased” remains unchanged.

sentences.simplified: 近些年随着人们观念的更新，骨灰存放方式也悄悄发生了改变。
sentences.traditional: 近些年隨著人們觀念的更新，骨灰存放方式也悄悄發生了改變。
sentences.pinyin: jìn xiē nián suí zhe rén men guān niàn de gēng xīn gǔ huī cún fàng fāng shì yě qiāo qiāo fā shēng le gǎi biàn

sentences.simplified: 在火葬的基础上出现了很多新的方式。
sentences.traditional: 在火葬的基礎上出現了很多新的方式。
sentences.pinyin: zài huǒ zàng de jī chǔ shang chū xiàn le hěn duō xīn de fāng shì
sentences.english: In recent years, as people’s attitudes have progressed, the ways in which ashes are kept have also quietly changed.

sentences.simplified: 比如，“绿色殡葬”，这是一种把骨灰直接葬入树下或草坪中的方式。
sentences.traditional: 比如，“綠色殯葬”，這是一種把骨灰直接葬入樹下或草坪中的方式。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú lǜ sè bìn zàng zhè shì yì zhǒng bǎ gǔ huī zhí jiē zàng rù shù xià huò cǎo píng zhōng de fāng shì
sentences.english: Many new methods based on cremation have emerged.

sentences.simplified: 人们将亲人骨灰、鲜花瓣和泥土一起葬在树根四周、草坪之中。
sentences.traditional: 人們將親人骨灰、鮮花瓣和泥土一起葬在樹根四周、草坪之中。
sentences.pinyin: rén men jiāng qīn rén gǔ huī xiān huā bàn hé ní tǔ yì qǐ zàng zài shù gēn sì zhōu cǎo píng zhī zhōng
sentences.english: For example, a “green funeral” is a method in which the remains are cremated underneath a tree or on a lawn.

sentences.simplified: 绿色安葬象征着生命长绿、精神永存，
sentences.traditional: 綠色安葬象徵著生命長綠、精神永存，
sentences.pinyin: lǜ sè ān zàng xiàng zhēng zhe shēng mìng cháng lǜ jīng shén yǒng cún
sentences.english: People bury the ashes of their deceased relatives, along with fresh flower petals and soil, around tree roots or on a lawn.

sentences.simplified: 也符合人们“入土为安”的传统观念。
sentences.traditional: 也符合人們“入土為安”的傳統觀念。
sentences.pinyin: yě fú hé rén men rù tǔ wéi ān de chuán tǒng guān niàn
sentences.english: A green burial symbolizes an evergreen life and an everlasting spirit.

sentences.simplified: 还有海葬，就是将骨灰撒入大海的葬法。
sentences.traditional: 還有海葬，就是將骨灰撒入大海的葬法。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu hǎi zàng jiù shì jiāng gǔ huī sǎ rù dà hǎi de zàng fǎ
sentences.english: This is also consistent with the traditional concept of “burial bringing peace to the deceased”.

sentences.simplified: 骨灰撒海，冲破了传统的“入土为安”观念。
sentences.traditional: 骨灰撒海，衝破了傳統的“入土為安”觀念。
sentences.pinyin: gǔ huī sǎ hǎi chōng pò le chuán tǒng de rù tǔ wéi ān guān niàn
sentences.english: There is also sea burial, a burial method in which ashes are scattered into the sea.

sentences.simplified: 人从自然中来，又回到自然中去。
sentences.traditional: 人從自然中來，又回到自然中去。
sentences.pinyin: rén cóng zì rán zhōng lái yòu huí dào zì rán zhōng qù
sentences.english: Scattering ashes into the sea breaks the traditional concept of “burial bringing peace to the deceased”.
Humans come from nature and eventually return to nature.

sentences.simplified: 除了骨灰存放方式有了改变，人们对于骨灰的态度也发生了改变。
sentences.traditional: 除了骨灰存放方式有了改變，人們對於骨灰的態度也發生了改變。
sentences.pinyin: chú le gǔ huī cún fàng fāng shì yǒu le gǎi biàn rén men duì yú gǔ huī de tài du yě fā shēng le gǎi biàn

sentences.simplified: 现在很多年轻人会把去世亲人的骨灰做成饰品，比如戒指、项链等随身携带，
sentences.traditional: 現在很多年輕人會把去世親人的骨灰做成飾品，比如戒指、項鏈等隨身攜帶，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài hěn duō nián qīng rén huì bǎ qù shì qīn rén de gǔ huī zuò chéng shì pǐn bǐ rú jiè zhi xiàng liàn děng suí shēn xié dài
sentences.english: In addition to the changes in keeping ashes, people’s attitude towards the ashes themselves has also changed.

sentences.simplified: 这样就可以随时随地把亲人带在身边。
sentences.traditional: 這樣就可以隨時隨地把親人帶在身邊。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiù kě yǐ suí shí suí dì bǎ qīn rén dài zài shēn biān
sentences.english: Nowadays many young people turn their loved ones’ ashes into accessories, such as rings and necklaces.
This way, they can have their loved ones by their side anytime, anywhere.

sentences.simplified: 在你的国家，人们会选择什么方式去纪念去世的亲人呢？
sentences.traditional: 在你的國家，人們會選擇什麼方式去紀念去世的親人呢？
sentences.pinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā rén men huì xuǎn zé shén me fāng shì qù jì niàn qù shì de qīn rén ne

sentences.english: In your country, how do people remember deceased family members?

raw.synopsis: Learn about a new take on an old tradition.
sentence_translations: “Burial brings peace to the deceased” is a unique funeral concept in China.
Chinese people believe that only with a burial can the deceased rest in peace, and the living be at peace.
Therefore, although traditional burial has been replaced by cremation in China, ..
.. the tradition that “burial brings peace to the deceased” remains unchanged.
In recent years, as people’s attitudes have progressed, the ways in which ashes are kept have also quietly changed.
Many new methods based on cremation have emerged.
For example, a “green funeral” is a method in which the remains are cremated underneath a tree or on a lawn.
People bury the ashes of their deceased relatives, along with fresh flower petals and soil, around tree roots or on a lawn.
A green burial symbolizes an evergreen life and an everlasting spirit.
This is also consistent with the traditional concept of “burial bringing peace to the deceased”.
There is also sea burial, a burial method in which ashes are scattered into the sea.
Scattering ashes into the sea breaks the traditional concept of “burial bringing peace to the deceased”.
Humans come from nature and eventually return to nature.
In addition to the changes in keeping ashes, people’s attitude towards the ashes themselves has also changed.
Nowadays many young people turn their loved ones’ ashes into accessories, such as rings and necklaces.
This way, they can have their loved ones by their side anytime, anywhere.
In your country, how do people remember deceased family members?
